articles.title: 'Knowing they didn't suffer has been so important': Widow whose husband and 19-year-old son died in Titan submarine disaster tells of her relief at learning they went instantly
articles.summary: Christine Dawood, widow of Shahzada Dawood and mother of Suleman, both victims of the Titan submarine implosion, expressed relief upon learning their deaths were instantaneous. Her husband and 19-year-old son were among five who perished aboard the submersible exploring the Titanic wreck. This revelation provided comfort amidst the profound grief of losing her family in the international deep-sea tragedy.

articles.title: HNLC questions civilian safety amid military installations in Shillong
articles.summary: The proscribed Hynniewtrep National Liberation Council (HNLC) has expressed concerns regarding the siting of major military installations within civilian zones. This issue, involving a banned group and military presence, highlights ongoing internal security challenges and potential civil-military friction in certain regions. It's crucial for SSB aspirants to understand such dynamics concerning national security and the operational environment for armed forces.
